mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts above 1800 thousand units signals strong consumer demand and construction activity, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST exceeds 1800 thousand units, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the unemployment rate and increases in non-farm payrolls signal a tightening labor market that accelerates wage growth and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production, manufacturing output contraction signals reduced corporate capacity utilization and lower near-term earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the core CPI above 6.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 280.0, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low unemployment (below 4.0%), a concurrent rise in non-farm payrolls accelerates wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market tightness with wage pressures
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS rises month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and core CPI above 6.0% signal an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL > 280.0, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.
